name: Adobe Spectrum 2 (S2)
licence: Tokens and component API schemas: Apache-2.0 (github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data, formerly spectrum-tokens; npm @adobe/spectrum-tokens 15.5.0). React Spectrum / Spectrum CSS: Apache-2.0. The Adobe Clean / Adobe Clean Spectrum VF typefaces are RESTRICTED: 'exclusive use of Adobe products and software', served only through Adobe Fonts, never self-hosted; they cannot be used in our own projects. Fallbacks and Source Code Pro (OFL) can.
bestFor: creative-tool and editing UIs where the canvas is the hero and chrome must recede (Photoshop/Express/Firefly class)
content-browsing apps with cards, grids, side navigation and many component sizes
products that need an explicit size x density x platform matrix (XS-XL, compact/regular/spacious, desktop vs mobile scale)
teams that want a documented attention-hierarchy rule: one high-attention thing per view
avoidFor: brand-led marketing pages (the Adobe Clean face is not licensable and the palette is purposefully quiet)
playful or heavily illustrated consumer brands without adaptation
dense tabular back-office UIs needing sub-24px controls (smallest tier is 20px extra-small)
anything that must ship a self-hosted Adobe Clean

families: Adobe Clean Spectrum Serif VF / Adobe Clean Serif (companion, restricted)
Adobe Clean Display (brand/marketing only, via Adobe Fonts)
Web fallback order: Adobe Clean, Source Sans Pro, San Francisco, Roboto, Segoe UI, Trebuchet MS, Lucida Grande
Adobe Clean Han (CJK), Thai, Arabic, Hebrew, Devanagari
typography.notes: Desktop scale from font-size-25..1500 = 10,11,12,14,16,18,20,22,25,28,32,36,40,45,51,58,65,73 px: a Major Second ratio (x1.125) from base font-size-100 = 14px, rounded to whole px. Mobile scale is a separate set (~x1.2: font-size-100 = 17px, 200 = 19, 300 = 22, 400 = 24, 500 = 27, 600 = 31, 700 = 34, 800 = 39, 900 = 44). Line heights: Heading/Title/Detail/Component use per-size tokens line-height-font-size-N (about 130% shrinking to 115%, even px only; e.g. 14px -> 18, 16 -> 20, 20 -> 24, 28 -> 32, 36 -> 42, 73 -> 84); Body and Code use 1.5x, CJK 1.7x. The Body rows above are 1.5x of size. Heading default weight is 800 (Black 900 allowed for brand headings >=18px; light variants 300). Title is 700, Detail is 500 uppercase with +0.06em tracking in gray-600, Component text (buttons 700, action buttons 500, fields 400). Letter-spacing is 0 for everything except Detail. All caps is allowed only for Detail and long-form marketing, never inside components. Tabular numerals required for numbers in components. Paragraph measure target ~70 characters (50-120 hard range); never justify.

neutrals.note: Tokens ship as rgb(); converted to hex here. Single dark theme (used both for 'dark theme' and dark device mode). A third 'wireframe' set exists in the palette file. Gray-25 is the default page background; 25/50/75 reserved for background layers; 100/200/300 for low-contrast fills and borders; 800/900 for high-contrast fills and text. Detail text colour gray-600, heading colour gray-900, code colour gray-800.

accents.note: Every hue ships a 16-step scale 100..1600 in both light and dark (hues available: red, orange, yellow, brown, chartreuse, celery, green, seafoam, cyan, blue, indigo, purple, fuchsia, magenta, pink, turquoise, silver, cinnamon). Brand colours of Adobe apps (Ai orange, Ps blue, etc.) deliberately differ from system hues.

color.darkMode: One dark theme generated with the Leonardo contrast-based colour tool from key colours plus target contrast ratios, so each of the 16 steps has the same purpose in both themes (e.g. gray-800 is #292929 light / #dbdbdb dark; gray-25 #ffffff / #111111). The ladder is reversed in lightness, not recoloured: the same token name works in both. Background layers: base gray-25 in both; layer-1 gray-50 both; layer-2 gray-25 light / gray-75 dark; pasteboard gray-100 light / gray-25 dark; elevated gray-25 light / gray-75 dark with drop shadow. Drop-shadow opacity triples in dark (24/36/48% instead of 8/12/16%); popovers also get a border in dark. Accent step shifts: accent bg 900 light vs 800 dark, hover 1000 vs 700.
color.contrastNotes: Computed 2026-10-08 against #ffffff: gray-800 #292929 14.55:1; gray-700 #505050 8.06:1; gray-600 #717171 4.88:1 (lowest gray that passes small text); gray-500 #8f8f8f 3.23:1 (non-text 3:1 only); gray-400 #c6c6c6 1.71:1; blue-900 #3b63fb 4.81:1 as text or as background under white text. Dark: gray-600 #8a8a8a on #111 5.47:1; blue-900 dark #5681ff on #111 5.38:1; white on dark accent bg (blue-800 dark #4069fd) 4.51:1 (just passing). Spectrum's own rule: all active states of components are >=3:1 against the background, text >=4.5:1; disabled and decorative are exempt. Never recolour or run color functions (lighten/darken) on tokens: tints are perceptually tuned. Hue-vibration warning: do not place high-chroma hues of equal lightness adjacent. Static black text (not white) must be used on yellow, orange, chartreuse and celery fills.

spacing.base: no fixed base: a geometric/perceptual progression that rounds to familiar numbers; 8px = spacing-100

radius.rule: S2 rounds everything ('no sharp corners'). Defaults: small 4px (checkbox, in-field button), medium 8px (most components, XS/S cards), large 10px (M/L cards, panels, select boxes, toolbars), extra-large 16px (dialogs), full = height/2 (buttons, avatars, FAB, search field). Per component size the medium family steps 6/7/8/9/10 for XS/S/M/L/XL and the small family 3/4/5/6 on a Major Second scale so radius grows with control size. Nested radii: outer - gap = inner for focus rings; for cards use optical balance, never force the formula. Desktop and mobile share base radius. iOS: use continuous (squircle) corners and concentric APIs.

shadows: drop-shadow-emphasized (default container emphasis): 0 2px 8px ambient, 0 1px 4px transition, 0 0 1px key; colours 8% / 4% / 8% black (light), x3 in dark
drop-shadow-elevated (menus, tooltips, popovers, floating toolbars): 0 4px 12px, 0 2px 6px, 0 0 2px; key 12%
every shadow is a three-layer composite (key = edge, transition, ambient = depth), black base; dark theme opacity = 3x light
no shadow on containers by default; overlay behind dialogs replaces the shadow
depth.borders: Two widths only: 2px (default, focus rings, selected) and 1px (dense: accordions, tables); border-width-400 = 4px for large emphasis. 'Borders when necessary only': separate with spacing, section titles and background layers first. Divider end caps square when edge-to-edge, fully rounded when floating. Focus indicator: 2px thick, 2px gap, colour blue-800 (side focus indicator 4px).
depth.blur: No blur/glass material is specified. Overlay colour is black (overlay-color) with theme-dependent opacity; backdrop blur: unknown / not part of the system.

motion.notes: Numeric motion tokens come from @spectrum-css/tokens 16.0.2 (Spectrum 1 CSS, animation-duration-100..6000); the S2 tokens file and S2 motion docs publish NO numeric duration or easing tokens: treat these as the best public values. S2 motion model: directional (linear = forward/progress, diagonal = context switch, clockwise = indeterminate hold), interaction (microinteractions such as a 'down' state that shrinks the control: tokens component-size-difference-down -2px, width-ratio-down 0.3333, perspective clamp 24-96px), wayfinding (unfinished). Large-area motion must honour reduced-motion. Motion is allowed to carry brand personality but must add meaning.

controlHeightsPx.buttons: min-width: 2.25x height; padding each side = half height
controlHeightsPx.density scope: only collections (lists, groups, tables) and containers (cards, toolbars) take density; basic controls do not. Compact = every spacing token one step down; spacious = one step up.

components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Each component page carries an explicit States table with Supported / Not supported for Default, Hover, Down, Keyboard focus, Disabled, Selected, Dragged, Error (e.g. Button: Selected/Dragged/Error not supported; Text field: Down not supported, Focus-hover and Focus-not-hover separate, Error supported). Options listed per component: size (XS-XL, medium default), style (fill/outline), staticColor (black/white), isEmphasized, isQuiet, isPending, isDisabled, isRequired, labelPosition, necessityIndicator. Also Behaviors, Usage guidelines, Content standards, Internationalization/RTL and a WCAG 2.2 compliance table per component. 70 documented component pages; 91 token files / 2,500 tokens.

tokenArchitecture: Three tiers: primitive/global (blue-900, gray-100, spacing-100, corner-radius-75, font-size-100, component-height-100), semantic (accent-background-color-default, negative-content-color-default, container-padding-medium, group-gap-small, base-padding-vertical-large) and sparse component-specific (tooltip-maximum-width, button-minimum-width-multiplier). Names read broad-to-specific left to right: [what is communicated or where applied]-[what it affects]-[how]-[option]-[state]. Structural templates (base, accessory, group, list, container, banner) own the spacing semantics so a component is a composition of structures, not a list of bespoke numbers. Values can be a literal, an alias {token}, or a set keyed by theme (light/dark/wireframe) or scale (desktop/mobile). 2,500 tokens, DTCG-style JSON with UUIDs and JSON-schema per token type (color, color-set, dimension, drop-shadow composite, multiplier, font-weight...).
distinctiveness: Gray-first UI where the accent blue is rationed ('one high-attention element per page'); pill buttons and 16px dialogs; heavy 800-weight headings against 400 body; spacing replaces dividers; down state shrinks controls; layers system (pasteboard / layer-1 / layer-2 / elevated) built for editing canvases; three-layer composite shadows; a full desktop-vs-mobile scale for every dimension.
weaknesses: Adobe Clean is not licensable outside Adobe, so the typographic identity cannot be reproduced
motion is the thinnest part: no numeric S2 tokens
palette is deliberately quiet; hue-rich brand work needs adapting

documentation is spread across spectrum.adobe.com, a corporate mirror (s2.spectrum.corp.adobe.com, referenced but not public) and the open data repo, and the repo/package names changed (spectrum-tokens became spectrum-design-data)
many size/density options (XS-XL x compact/spacious x desktop/mobile) multiply spec surface
takeaways: Make attention a first-class rule: a page has ONE high-attention element; selected-state nav must not compete with the primary action
Spacing over borders: group with proximity tokens and section titles; borders only when spacing fails, and only one or two widths
Geometric (perceptually spaced) spacing and radius scales tied to component size, not a flat 8px multiple
Name tokens broad-to-specific and compose components from structural templates (base/accessory/group/list/container)
Per-component State support table (supported/not supported) so unsupported states are decisions, not omissions
Layered backgrounds (base, layer-1, layer-2, elevated, pasteboard) that map to different tokens in dark theme
Same-purpose colour steps in light and dark (step N does the same job), enabling a single semantic token set
Density is a spacing property of collections and containers only; do not density-scale basic controls
